overall_goal: Clean the kitchen, put away items, and prepare the biscuit bowl

goals.description: Wash and load the chopping board and knives into the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person rinses the chopping board and knives, lathers them, and places them into the dishwasher.

goals.description: Wash and store a plate and a mug
goals.rationale: The person lathers and rinses a plate and a mug, placing the plate in the dishwasher and the mug on the drainer.

goals.description: Gather dirty dishes and utensils into the sink
goals.rationale: The person clears the countertop by moving empty bowls, plates, the food processor bowl and lid, the blade, and an empty pot into or next to the sink.

goals.description: Put away notepad, cocoa powder, and plastic pieces
goals.rationale: The person tidies up by storing a notepad, a tin of cocoa powder, and several plastic pieces in their respective places.

goals.description: Store scissors, oranges, can opener, and kitchen towel
goals.rationale: The person continues tidying by putting away scissors, meshes of oranges, a can opener, and a kitchen towel roll, while discarding a piece of plastic.

goals.description: Load knives into the dishwasher and close it
goals.rationale: The person places two more knives into the dishwasher's cutlery tray and then closes all the dishwasher drawers and door.

goals.description: Put a towel in the washing machine
goals.rationale: The person picks up a towel, opens the washing machine cupboard, throws the towel inside, and closes the doors.

goals.description: Prepare the biscuit bowl for the dates
goals.rationale: The person moves the bowl of crumbled biscuits and creates a well in the center to make room for the dates.

goals.description: Manage the cooking pot and dates
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to retrieve a fallen date, rests the spatula on the pot, turns off the burner, and holds the pot handle.
